0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 13th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-4, 3rd in the Northwest) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, the Clippers' 11th of the 2026-27 season, with the Clippers having lost their last game and the Thunder their last two. The Thunder beat the Clippers 108-101 in Oklahoma City on October 25, leaving the Clippers trailing 0-1 this season after losing 0-3 to them in 2025-26. Clippers players out are Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), with Cam Christie listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision; Thunder players out are Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee), with Ajay Mitchell listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision.
